install.title: Install the game
install.intro: Pick where Tree of Savior Classic goes. The launcher downloads everything and keeps it updated.
install.resumeIntro: The last download into this folder did not finish. Finished files are kept; only the rest is fetched.
install.problem.invalid: Type a full path, like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.forbidden: Program Files and Windows folders are not allowed. Pick a folder like C:\Hyped Games\ToS Classic.
install.problem.not-writable: No permission to write here. Pick another folder or drive.
install.problem.not-enough-space: Not enough free space on this drive.
install.problem.no-manifest: Could not reach the update server to size the download. Try again.
install.partialHint: An unfinished install was found here — it will continue from where it stopped.
install.completeHint: A game install was found here — it will be checked and updated.
news.title: News
settings.title: Settings
settings.invalidPath: No game install found there: the folder needs release\Yuka.exe or a previous launcher install.
settings.allowOffline: Allow playing while the update server is unreachable
settings.repairHint: Re-checks every downloaded patch and re-downloads anything corrupted.
error.offline: Could not check for updates. Check your connection.
error.offlinePlayable: You can still play with the current files.
error.manifest-invalid: The update server returned something unexpected. Try again later.
error.launcher-outdated: A newer launcher version is required to continue.
error.disk-full: Not enough disk space for the update.
error.file-locked: A game file is in use. Close the game (and antivirus) and try again.
error.game-running: The game is running. Close it to update.
error.manifest-cdn-desync: The patch server is being updated right now. Try again in a moment.
error.bad-game-path: Game folder not found. Set it in Settings.
error.patch-dir-readonly: No permission to write into the game folder.
error.av-suspected: Your antivirus may have blocked a game file. Add the game folder to its exclusions.
error.elevation-declined: The game needs administrator permission to start. Accept the Windows prompt and try again.
